title: nettrace_3gpp_32_423: Fix stale session context on seek_read (second pass)
description:
```
Per-session state (session_time, UE ID) in file_info is updated
sequentially during the first pass as each <traceRecSession> is
encountered. During seek_read (second pass, used by the GUI and
tshark -2), the read buffer only contains the <msg>...</msg> block.
The <traceRecSession> tag is not present, so the session context
was never properly restored — causing every frame to display the
last session's UE ID and potentially wrong timestamps.

Fix by recording the per-packet session context in a hash table
(keyed by data_offset) during the sequential read, and restoring
it at the start of seek_read before building the packet.
```

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)
